description: Narrow towards a purchase without inventing keywords. One call returns children[] and childrenDeep[] with estimated counts, brands[] each with an engineParam you can pass straight back to search_products.engineParam, the shop's own facets[], aspectTiles[], siblings[], related[] and a deals[] rail. GET /api/agent/browse/tree/<slug>, or GET /api/agent/browse/tree/<slug>/<nodeId> for any category under a department. No wallet and no signature. contentAt is when those deal prices were read. Counts are estimates and countScope says so. A shelf already read answers from cache; a cold one costs one call against the catalogue quota shared with shoppers, so read the shelf you want rather than walking the tree.

nodeId.description: A category id under that department, from children[].id or childrenDeep[].id. Omit for the department itself.

slug.description: The `slug` field of a department from list_categories.

name: get_category
title: Read one shelf: children, brands, filters and a deals rail
